# Platform settings · User entries

## Built-in chat

<a id="BuiltinChatEnabled"></a>

### Built-in chat

Key `BuiltinChatEnabled` · Type bool · Default `true`

Where: Platform settings › User entries › Built-in chat

Lets users try models in the console's playground and shows the quick-start chat on the dashboard. Off keeps the playground pages visible but disables running a request, and points users to the API docs instead. API keys and requests from other clients are not affected.

## Chat links

<a id="ChatLinks"></a>

### Chat links

Key `ChatLinks` · Type json · Default `empty`

Where: Platform settings › User entries › Chat links

The chat clients listed for users, each with a name, an address, a sort order and whether it shows. Stored as a JSON array of {id, name, url, show, sort}; the card edits one entry at a time and saves it right away. The list is published in the site status for clients that read it; no API key is added to the links. Empty means no chat links.

Examples:

- `[{"id":"a1","name":"Web chat","url":"https://chat.example.com","show":true,"sort":1}]` One visible entry named Web chat.
- `[{"id":"a1","name":"Web chat","url":"https://chat.example.com","show":false,"sort":1}]` The entry is kept but hidden.

See also: [Chat link (legacy)](./site.md#ChatLink) · [Built-in chat](./entries.md#BuiltinChatEnabled)
